name: 00-home
title: Start from the SSC Vault diagram
caption: Keep this HTML page as the home tab. Green links open live services; blue paths open source. We will return to the map at each handoff.

name: 02b-open-vault
title: Open the Vault from the browser box
caption: Follow the green Open Vault link inside the diagram. This opens the live job board in a new tab; the diagram stays available on the left.

name: 03c-configure
title: Choose FastSolv and scroll to its input
caption: Open Skill Catalog, select Aqueous Solubility Prediction, then scroll below the cards to its form. This value-input example runs through the shared Python path.

name: 04-submit
title: Submit one value and watch the job appear
caption: Run sends CCO to the shared admission endpoint. The Runs board shows the new job while GitHub works asynchronously; it will return a CSV result.

name: 05-admission
title: Return to the map: admission and dispatch
caption: The submit-job source is in the Run admission box. It checks the organization subscription and module entitlement before reserving quota and creating a job.

name: 07-execution
title: Follow the map into GitHub Actions
caption: Return to the diagram and enlarge the component labels. Open execution runs from the GitHub runner box, then select the run matching our newly submitted job.

name: 08-workflow
title: Open the runner source from the same box
caption: The blue run-module.yml link opens the shared workflow. After staging the input, it runs the module helper, validates the declared output, and reports success through the callback.

name: 09-module
title: Follow the module package to its Python entrypoint
caption: The modules/ link leads to the scientific package. FastSolv calls run_predictions; its entrypoint writes the CSV that the shared runner delivers.

name: 10-file-input
title: Return to the map for the file-input path
caption: Open Vault from the diagram again. Molecular Structure Recognition uses DECIMER: upload a chemical structure image instead of typing a value.

name: 11-submit-file
title: Submit the image through the same job interface
caption: Attach caffeine.png and click Run. The file-input branch creates a job, stages the private input, then dispatches the same GitHub workflow with the selected module.

name: 12-stage
title: The file is staged after admission
caption: Back in the Run admission box, open submit-job. After admission succeeds, it uploads the input under the job ID in private job-inputs storage before dispatching the runner.

name: 13-container
title: The manifest selects the container and output
caption: From the module-package box, open DECIMER’s manifest. It declares a file input, the Dockerfile runtime, and output/smiles_result.csv; the shared runner follows this contract.

name: 14-callback
title: Return through the callback box
caption: Open job-callback/core.ts from the map. The callback uploads a private result under a unique attempt path, then records success with the result reference.

name: 15b-database
title: Follow the result into Supabase
caption: Use Open database in the Supabase box, then open SQL Editor. We will read only the two demonstration jobs and their status and result-file fields.

name: 17-storage
title: Open the private results bucket from the map
caption: Follow Open Storage in the Supabase box, then open job-results. Results are organized by job ID and upload attempt; the bucket remains private.

name: 18c-authorize
title: Return to the map for result retrieval
caption: The get-result source lives in the callback and result-delivery box. It checks the caller’s organization membership before allowing a successful job’s file to be downloaded.

name: 19-frontend
title: The browser follows the job lifecycle
caption: The pinned runs-page source polls every five seconds while jobs are active. The current live Vault has a newer Skill Catalog and visualization UI; this excerpt explains the older tracked polling contract.

name: 20-value-result
title: Return from the map to the completed value job
caption: Open Vault from the browser box again. The new FastSolv run has succeeded; Visualize opens the returned solubility data for the same demonstration.

name: 21c-file-result
title: Compare the completed image result
caption: The image job returns smiles_result.csv. Raw shows the predicted SMILES string and its length; this is the same file located in private Storage.

name: 21e-completed-workflow
title: Check the completed container workflow
caption: Return to Open execution runs on the map and open the DECIMER job. The completed steps show file input preparation, module execution, output validation and the success callback.

name: 22-sequence
title: Read the complete request sequence
caption: Back on the HTML page, follow admission into asynchronous execution. The browser polls while the runner works; the callback stores the result, and authorized retrieval closes the loop.

name: 23-data-model
title: Keep the organization and job records connected
caption: The data model ties membership, the module registry and jobs to the organization. Quota admission counts jobs in the billing period and revalidates subscription state before inserting a queued job.

name: 24-overview
title: The same loop, at a simpler level
caption: A member clicks Run; Vault admits the job and dispatches GitHub. The module produces output, the callback stores it, and the browser retrieves it. Use the diagram links to retrace any handoff.
